title: The Role of Agentic Instruction Categories for Code Generation: A Study of Five Python Libraries
title_zh: 智能体指令类别在代码生成中的作用：一项针对五种 Python 库的研究

paragraphs.en: 一项研究探讨了智能体指令类别在代码生成中的作用，评估了五类指令在五种Python库中的效果。 Agentic coding systems increasingly rely on repository-level agent files, such as AGENTS.md, to communicate project knowledge and developer intent. However, it remains unclear which categories of agent instructions enable efficient agent-file generation and accurate code generation. We evaluate five instruction categories: Repository Overview, Function Description, Implementation Detail, Testing, and Reconstruction Steps, across all 31 non-empty combinations using two Large Language Models (LLMs), Gemma 4 and GPT-5.4, and five human-written Python libraries. Our study addresses two research questions, comprising five sub-questions, on agent file generation and code generation. Results show that the number of instructions alone does not determine token usage for agent-file generation, with substantial variation across models and libraries. Although most AI-generated libraries compiled successfully regardless of the instruction combination, functional correctness remained limited. No Gemma 4 variant passed all tests, whereas 12.99% of GPT-5.4 variants did. Function Description achieved Gemma 4's highest partial-pass rate, while Reconstruction Steps achieved GPT-5.4's highest full-pass rate. For structural similarity to human-written code, Reconstruction Steps was most frequently associated with libraries closest to the originals in Lines of File and total Cyclomatic Complexity, while Testing and Reconstruction Steps were jointly most frequent for File Count and Function Count.
paragraphs.zh: 一项研究探讨了智能体指令类别在代码生成中的作用，评估了五类指令在五种Python库中的效果。Agentic coding systems increasingly rely on repository-level agent files, such as AGENTS.md, to communicate project knowledge and developer intent. 然而，目前尚不清楚哪些类别的智能体指令能够实现高效的智能体文件生成和准确的代码生成。 我们使用两个大语言模型（LLM）Gemma 4 和 GPT-5.4，以及五个由人工编写的Python库，评估了五类指令：仓库概述、函数描述、实现细节、测试和重建步骤，涵盖全部31种非空组合。 我们的研究围绕智能体文件生成和代码生成提出了两个研究问题，包含五个子问题。 结果表明，仅凭指令数量并不能决定智能体文件生成的令牌使用量，不同模型和库之间存在显著差异。 尽管无论采用哪种指令组合，大多数AI生成的库都能成功编译，但功能正确性仍然有限。 没有任何Gemma 4变体通过全部测试，而GPT-5.4的变体中有12.99%通过了全部测试。 函数描述实现了Gemma 4最高的部分通过率，而重建步骤实现了GPT-5.4最高的完全通过率。 在与人工编写代码的结构相似性方面，重建步骤最常与在文件行数和总圈复杂度上最接近原始代码的库相关联，而测试和重建步骤在文件数量和函数数量上共同最为频繁地与最接近原始代码的库相关联。
